card.name: Release after extended in drug names
card.fires_on: The word release (or -release) right after "extended" in names of extended-release products, such as tablets, capsules or injectable suspensions.

modes.label: Hyphenated -release
modes.description: The hyphen plus release completes "extended-release" before a dosage form.
modes.example: with Desvenlafaxine Extended-Release Tablets Table 8: Clinically Important Drug Interactions with Desvenlafaxine Extended-<<Release>> Tablets Monoamine Oxidase Inhib

modes.label: Spaced release
modes.description: The word release follows "extended" with a space, as in an ER abbreviation or product name.
modes.example: In vivo drug interactions studies showed an increase in metformin extended<< release>> (ER) when coadministered

card.plain: It marks the word "release" in the phrase "extended-release" in drug product names.
